inputs.text: Wide establishing view of this world, from wherever it looks most striking. The city drifts above a sea of ochre sand, structures of blown, iridescent glass clinging to massive, slow-moving buoyancy platforms. Harsh, bleached sunlight refracts through crystalline spires and colossal, dormant steam vents. The place is completely deserted and uninhabited: nobody is there, no people, no figures, no silhouettes. golden hour backlight, warm sun flare, long shadows, dreamy atmosphere. Cinematic still frame from a live-action feature film: realistic light, natural colour and texture, no text or lettering.
